h1: Stove & Oven Repair in Houston, TX
subtitle: Oven not heating, burners that won’t light or a temperature that is way off? We repair gas and electric ranges, cooktops and wall ovens the same day, with a free estimate first.
excerpt: Same-day stove and oven repair in Houston for gas and electric ranges, wall ovens and cooktops of every brand, with a free estimate and a 90-day warranty.

faqs.q: Can you repair my stove or oven the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. We schedule stove and oven repairs for the same day across Houston and nearby cities. Call us or use the booking form to get started.

faqs.q: What should I do if I smell gas?
faqs.a: Don’t use switches or burners. Leave the house and call your gas company’s emergency line or 911 from outside. Contact us for the repair once the gas company says it is safe.

faqs.q: Why won’t my gas oven heat up?
faqs.a: The most common cause is a weak igniter that glows but doesn’t open the gas valve. A faulty valve or control can cause the same symptom.

faqs.q: Why is my oven temperature wrong?
faqs.a: A failing temperature sensor, a weak igniter or a control that needs calibration. An oven thermometer shows how far off it really is.

faqs.q: Do you repair Viking, Thermador and other professional ranges?
faqs.a: Yes. We repair all major brands, including Viking, Thermador, Thor, GE, Samsung, LG, KitchenAid and Jenn-Air.

faqs.q: Is there a charge for the estimate?
faqs.a: No. The estimate comes free and before any repair, so you see the price first and decide.

faqs.q: What warranty do stove and oven repairs have?
faqs.a: Stove and oven repairs are covered by our 90-day warranty on parts and labor.
